name: B3-fastapi__full-stack-fastapi-template-why-1
answer_head: - **Reason: security.** Commit 546dc8b (2019-05-28, ":lock: Update login.py to receive password as body (#33)") changed `new_password` from a query parameter to a body parameter. Its message says "for security" and cites a StackOverflow thread on whether query-string parameters are secure over HTTPS
